notes: POOL: 18,342 cards are Commander-legal with colour identity subset of {B,R,W} (data/cards.csv, legal_commander=='legal' + color_identity_mask). 398 of them are Vampires by type_line; only 54 non-Vampire cards mention 'Vampire' in oracle text. That 54 is the whole Vampire-referencing support pool in Mardu — it is small, and 18 of those 54 are anti-Vampire HATE (Elite Inquisitor, Victim of Night, Cleansing Ray, Wooden Stake, Vampire Slayer, Undead Slayer, Midnight Duelist, Blazing Torch, Slayer of the Wicked, Mindless Null, Gift of Fangs, Circle of Confinement, New Blood, Olivia's Wrath, Accursed Duneyard, Riders of Gavony, Katilda, Anowon the Ruin Sage). A naive 'oracle contains Vampire' retrieval hands the architect cards that kill its own board; I excluded them by hand.

WHY THE DETERMINISTIC BASELINE MISSED THE DECK (reproducible): embeddings_ability.npy is effectively a mechanical-tag-set embedding. Edgar Markov's tag set is exactly 'attack_trigger, counters_plus, tokens'. His 6 nearest ability neighbours are Ant-Man Colony Commander (0.9982), Legion Warboss (0.9974), Boomer Scrapper (0.9961), Descendant of Storms (0.9961), Inspirited Vanguard (0.9953), Sonic the Hedgehog (0.9953) - all share that identical tag set and NONE is a Vampire. build_plan.json's top draw slot is Boomer Scrapper at similarity 0.9961. Cosine near 1.0 here means 'same tag set', not 'same function'. Do not rank this deck on similarity; I used it only as a reported signal, never as the sort key.

CLASSIFIER BUG (buff:pump regex): config.py MECHANICAL/ROLE pattern for buff:pump is r'gets? \+\d+/\+\d+ until end of turn|creatures you control get \+'. It requires the literal word 'creatures'. Modern typal templating drops it - 'Other Vampires you control get +1/+1' does NOT match. Of the 10 Vampire-pump cards in this colour pool, 4 are misclassified as body-only: Legion Lieutenant, Thirsting Bloodlord, Edgar Charmed Groom, Markov Baron (also Death-Priest of Myrkul). Legion Lieutenant - a 2-mana Vampire lord, the single most on-theme cheap card in the format - carries roles=['threat:body'] only, has NO mechanical_tags at all, is therefore ABSENT from synergy_graph.json entirely, and its ability-embedding cosine to Edgar is -0.3664. Every automated signal in the repo says this card is irrelevant. It is the deck's best two-drop. I hand-seeded it.

CLASSIFIER MIS-TAG (removal:edict): pattern is r'sacrifices? a (?:creature|permanent)', which fires on your OWN sacrifice costs. 296 of the 450 removal:edict cards in this colour pool (66%) are self-sacrifice outlets or costs, not opponent-facing interaction - Viscera Seer, Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar, Carrion Feeder, Witch's Oven, Vampiric Rites, Goblin Bombardment, Bone Splinters, Diabolic Intent. I filtered these out of the removal bucket. If the architect counts 'removal' by role tag it will believe this deck has far more interaction than it does.

STRUCTURAL BLIND SPOT (typal payoffs never say the tribe name): the strongest Vampire-tribal cards in Mardu are type-agnostic - 'as this enters, choose a creature type'. Herald's Horn (#147), Patchwork Banner (#209), Urza's Incubator (#314), Vanquisher's Banner (#364), Door of Destinies (#1084), Icon of Ancestry (#2326), Metallic Mimic (#1050), Adaptive Automaton (#1755), Bloodline Pretender (#1814), Maskwood Nexus (#490), Roaming Throne (#133), Coat of Arms (#962), Cover of Darkness (#1440), Renewed Solidarity (#1813), Patriarch's Bidding (#1439). None contains the string 'Vampire'; none carries a tribal role; several carry no role at all. No text search for the tribe and no role query finds them. I added a 'chosen type' detector to surface them. This is a real gap in card_roles.json for every typal commander, not just this one.

DATA BUG (Unfinity Sticker Sheets are legal_commander=='legal'): 48 rows with set_code 'sunf' and type_line 'Stickers' pass the legality + colour-identity filter. They have null edhrec_rank and real mechanical_tags, so they score. My first pass surfaced Familiar Beeble Mascot, Sticky Kavu Daredevil, Playable Delusionary Hydra, Carnival Elephant Meteor and Goblin Coward Parade into wincon/draw. These are not castable cards. I excluded set_code=='sunf' and required a non-null edhrec_rank. Any consumer of cards.csv that filters only on legal_commander will hit this.

COMBO BRACKET TAGS ARE NOT A POWER JUDGEMENT: combo_details.json 'bracket' maps Commander Spellbook's letter tag (config.py COMBO_BRACKET_TAGS: E->1, C/O->2, P/S->3, R->4). 71,156 of 83,250 combos (85%) carry E->bracket 1. Bracket 1 here means 'Spellbook tagged it Exhibition', which in practice means 'not curated into a higher tier', NOT 'safe for a low-power deck'. All six Edgar lines below are tagged bracket 1 while producing infinite sacrifice/ETB/drain loops. Read the 'produces' field, not the bracket number. For a bracket-3 target the two lines that actually matter are the two tagged 3: Bloodthirsty Conqueror + Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose (popularity 64,824) and Bloodthirsty Conqueror + Marauding Blight-Priest (33,935) - both are 2-card, on-curve, all-Vampire infinite drains that assemble incidentally. All three cards are in the wincon bucket; the architect should decide deliberately whether to run all three.

COMMANDER-DEPENDENT LINES: every Edgar line in combo_lines assumes Edgar Markov is the commander and that eminence tokens come from casting Vampires (including recasting Oathsworn Vampire from the graveyard) with Edgar in the command zone. 'Infinite storm count' / 'Infinite ETB' in produces is the tell. Stack 004 in the goblin-storm deck refuted a combo-graph 'infinite' this way. All lines are flagged needs-a-stack-scenario; none should be presented as fact without a resolve-stack run.

GAME CHANGERS: 32 game_changer==true cards exist in this colour pool; I surfaced 9 (ramp: Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, Mana Vault; removal: Orcish Bowmasters; tutor: Vampiric Tutor, Demonic Tutor, Enlightened Tutor, Gamble, Imperial Seal). Bracket 3 permits at most 3. They are flagged game_changer:true so the architect can count and cut. Note the tutor bucket cannot be filled to depth without them - unrestricted tutors in Mardu are overwhelmingly on the list; the non-GC alternatives I surfaced (Diabolic Intent, Wishclaw Talisman, Insatiable Avarice, Grim Tutor, Profane Tutor, Entomb) are the realistic bracket-3 replacements.

BUCKET I COULD NOT FILL HONESTLY - SWEEPER: this is an aggro deck that wants the widest board at the table. Every card in the sweeper bucket except three is symmetric and kills its own deck. The three that are not: The Meathook Massacre (-X/-X plus 'whenever a creature YOU control dies, each opponent loses 1 life' - it is a drain engine that happens to sweep), Legion's Initiative (exiles YOUR creatures and returns them with +1/+1 haste - a one-sided reset), Amalia Benavides Aguirre (Vampire; its sweep is conditional on lifegain and it is a body first). I ranked those three first and filled the rest to depth as requested, but the data cannot tell you which sweepers a go-wide deck should actually run - that is an architect call. Treat the tail of this bucket as reference, not recommendation.

BUCKET I COULD NOT FILL ON-THEME - PROTECTION: 0 of 26 protection candidates are Vampires and none is tribal. The bucket is generic white/Mardu indestructible-and-protection effects. The go-wide-relevant ones are the team-wide instants (Flawless Maneuver, Unbreakable Formation, Make a Stand, Rootborn Defenses, Grand Crescendo, Duty Beyond Death); the single-target Mother of Runes / Giver of Runes / Gods Willing tier protects one creature, which is a poor fit for a board the deck deliberately spreads wide. Boros Charm (roles include protection:self) ranked into removal rather than protection because the role classifier reads its damage mode first - the architect may want it here instead.

ROLE COVERAGE: card_roles.json meta reports coverage 0.863 across all 34,322 cards and specific_coverage 0.6759. In THIS pool 2,304 of 18,342 Commander-legal Mardu cards (12.6%) carry no role entry at all, and 4,710 (25.7%) are absent from synergy_graph.json (synergy is tag-rule driven, so a card with no mechanical_tags gets no entry). Absence of a role is not evidence of absence of the function - Coat of Arms and Door of Destinies both carry roles=NONE and are among the strongest cards for this deck. The 'roles' field in each candidate reports what the classifier said, including 'NONE (unclassified)'.

SYNERGY vs SIMILARITY: the 'synergies' field on each candidate is from synergy_graph.json (complementary, rule-labelled: 'Tokens + Anthem', 'Sac + Death Trigger', 'Attack Trigger + Tokens') and is a RETRIEVAL SHORTLIST, not a fit score - it cannot answer 'how well does X fit this deck'. The 'similarity' field is ability-embedding cosine to Edgar Markov (embeddings_ability.npy, row-positional, L2-normalised, dot product). They are different algorithms and I used neither as the primary ranking key; ranking is tribal-evidence + EDHREC rank + curve, with similarity as a 0.3-weight tiebreak.

AGGRO CURVE: the brief asks for cheap. Bucket medians land at cmc 2 for flex/ramp/removal/protection and cmc 3 for wincon/draw/recursion/tutor. The expensive on-theme cards I still surfaced (Coat of Arms 5, Crossway Troublemakers 6, Vein Ripper 6, Aurelia the Warleader 6, Champion of Dusk 5, Vanquisher's Banner 5, Patriarch's Bidding 5) are there because their effect scales with board width, which this deck has; they are the top of the curve, not the plan.

OBSOLESCENCE INDEX IS CREATURE-TYPE-BLIND: obsolescence_index.json compares supertype, tags, CMC, colour and stats but has no notion of creature type, so in a typal deck it recommends replacing a Vampire with a non-Vampire and destroying the payoff. Real examples it produced for this pool: 'Oathsworn Vampire -> Forsaken Miner (Lower CMC)' - Forsaken Miner is a Skeleton, so it triggers neither eminence nor any lord, and Oathsworn Vampire is a combo piece; 'Icon of Ancestry -> Fellwar Stone (Lower CMC, Additional: ramp)' - swaps a tribal anthem for a mana rock; 'Bartolome del Presidio -> Hungry Ghoul (Better Toughness)'. I only carried forward upgrades that survive the typal check (replacement is itself a Vampire, or the pair is a genuine strictly-cheaper same-effect swap).

WHAT THE DATA CANNOT SAY: (1) nothing in these artifacts models eminence itself - there is no 'commander is in the command zone' signal anywhere, so the token-per-Vampire-cast engine that defines this deck is invisible to every scorer; I encoded it by hand as a Vampire-type bonus. (2) There is no mana-base output here - build_plan.json already solved 36 lands hypergeometrically at >=94% on-curve for each of B/R/W; I did not touch it and lands are excluded from every bucket. (3) No card in cards.csv is scored for how it plays against three opponents; 'aggro' as a plan is an archetype judgement, not a data fact. (4) EDHREC rank is popularity across all decks, not fit for this one - Legion Lieutenant at #2983 outranks nothing, and Sol Ring at #1 tells you only that everyone plays Sol Ring.

advantages: replacement is itself a Vampire, so it also feeds eminence and lord anthems
